name: antigravity-token-monitor
description: Lightweight, zero-estimation status-bar token and trajectory monitor for Antigravity IDE

commands.title: Antigravity Token Monitor: Select Active Conversation

antigravityTokenMonitor.activePollingInt.description: Polling interval (in seconds) while active conversation is RUNNING.

antigravityTokenMonitor.idlePollingInter.description: Polling interval (in seconds) while conversation is IDLE.

antigravityTokenMonitor.showBackendUsage.description: Show backend model usage (input/cache/output tokens) in the details panel.

antigravityTokenMonitor.showModelName.description: Show model name prefix in the status bar.
